name: ADP API
summary: Access enterprise and mid-market payroll, time, and labor data via ADP APIs.
whatItDoes: Integrates with ADP Workforce Now and related products for payroll totals, time cards, and labor cost reporting — used by larger SMBs and multi-location operators.
privacyNotes: ADP integrations require marketplace certification. Payroll compliance rules vary by state — outputs are planning-only, not compliance filings.
